poc_summary: Objective: validate Dedicated throughput & unit economics for embeddings + semantic search. Targets: 200 qps sustained query load (top-k retrieval + rerank), nightly batch embed job ingest 5M documents over rolling 7 days (target 100k docs/hour), latency SLO top-k retrieval <60ms p50, cost reduction >=30% vs baseline. Scope: evaluate Redwood Dedicated with both Pinecone connector and native vector store path, test batching + prefix caching, collect token-level cost breakdown in Redwood Console. Deliverables: perf report, cost model, recommended deployment (hosted->dedicated transition plan).
